title: Chapter 1050
text:
The function of the mechanical carrier was the same as the host. While accommodating the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy, it could use its own psionic core to unleash Esper Abilities. It did not have to start from scratch like an ordinary host and could directly unleash very strong combat power.

The combat power depended on the performance of the carrier itself, the fusion rate, synchronization rate, and other parameters with the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy. Simply put, the situation was similar to EsGod. An Esper who was already strong to begin with became the host, and with the foundation of strength, he could unleash the power of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy right away.

However, the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy mainly provided energy, so it was just like a tool that was bound in the carrier. The one controlling the body to fight was the mechanical carrier itself or the combat artificial intelligence Spartan.

Because this carrier was only the first prototype, there was still a lot of room for improvement, so Han Xiao did not plan to turn it into an Apostle Weapon immediately.

"The model of this carrier should be called [Mysterious Energy Host — First Generation]. I'll decide on the official code name after it becomes an Apostle Weapon."

Han Xiao was very satisfied. He had a bunch of skills that could increase the upper limit of his mechanical abilities, and there was still an empty slot for an Apostle Weapon.

"Okay, hum … model has been recorded. Database complete."

Han Xiao nodded, sized up the Mysterious Energy Host carefully, and asked, "How do you feel?"

The next moment, a psychic wave was released, and the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy inside spoke. "It's a bit cramped and uncomfortable. Give me a better carrier in the future."

"Don't worry, the prototype is already out. The optimization is very simple." Han Xiao waved his hands. His strengthening skills were also very powerful.

"Humph, change the carrier to a mechanical life as soon as possible. That way, at least there'll be someone to communicate with me, unlike now," the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy complained.

Han Xiao suddenly thought of something. "By the way, do you think I can cut you into eight pieces and put them on different Mysterious Energy Hosts? That way, I'll have a Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy squad."

"Don't even think about it!" The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy exploded. "You're not allowed to split my body! Absolutely! Yes! No! Yes! "

"Such a big reaction. Is this behavior very uncomfortable to you?" Han Xiao was curious. He was mainly thinking about EsGod's behavior in his previous life and could not help but ask.

"Humph, it's equivalent to you dismembering a person, and he still has to watch other people use his body parts as weapons, waving his arms and legs in battle, playing with his body and wasting his flesh. Plus, all his body parts can still feel pain, which can be transmitted back to the brain. Don't you think that's good?" The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy was dissatisfied.

"… Cough, just pretend I didn't mention it."

Han Xiao thought about it for a moment. It seemed that this scene was a little perverted. He coughed dryly and acted as if nothing had happened.

He then tested the combat power of the First Generation Mysterious Energy Host and the various ways to use his Esper abilities. The result was very satisfactory to him.

As a compound Super High Risk Esper Ability, the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy had a lot of abilities. It could strengthen the body, radiate powerful energy of both psychic and spatial attributes, and fly at high speed. The more advanced uses included shuttling between secondary dimensions, extracting energy from the core of a planet, invisible psychic energy, gravity springs, and so on.

At this time, because the First Generation Mysterious Energy Host had not received the bonuses of a mechanical life form and an Apostle Weapon, his combat power was far from reaching the Beyond Grade A level. However, in Han Xiao's calculations, once the Mysterious Energy Host became an Apostle Weapon, with the flexibility of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy, he would become the strongest existence among the Apostle Weapons. Even Psionic Prime, who had evolved for many years, might not be his match.

"As long as the optimization is completed, the Mysterious Energy Host will become my number one fighter. He might even be able to defeat ordinary Beyond Grade As."

Having obtained a powerful combatant, Han Xiaoxin was overjoyed.

At this time, Philip suddenly trembled and said, "Master, hum … Black Star Palace sent a message. A Beyond Grade A is looking for you."

"Who is it?" Han Xiao's eyes narrowed.

To think that it was the Black Star Palace. Could it be that someone had gone to his territory and attacked his headquarters?

That person is a little too bold. Does he think that the Black Star Palace that I spent a lot of money to build is made of paper? Plus, with the fleet in his headquarters, there are less than two Beyond Grade As. It is basically impossible for them to pose a threat to Black Star Palace.

"Er, it's neither. It's the dynasty's ally, Yin Ying."

Han Xiao was stunned and a little puzzled.

What is the meaning of this guy coming to my headquarters to look for me?

"Who's receiving him now? Did he express his intentions?"

"Ames met him. He said that he brought a gift and wants to exchange it for the right to use the Evolution Cube."

"I see." Han Xiao understood.

Back then, because he had won the battle with Yin Ying, Yin Ying did not have the chance to be baptized by the Evolution Cube. He had never mentioned it again, probably because he was looking for a bargaining chip to exchange for it.

"Then, what did he bring me?" Han Xiao was curious.

"It seems to be some rare blueprints. I don't know where he got them."

"Blueprints … that's not bad."

Han Xiao had originally planned to be on good terms with Yin Ying, so he was very lenient with his demands for Yin Ying. As long as the other party showed a good attitude, he would lend the Evolution Cube. In this regard, Han Xiao's style was to treat people like Heber differently. Even if he gave him the Bloodshed Land, he would not lend the Evolution Cube.

"What a coincidence. My main body is not in the headquarters." Han Xiao rubbed Philip's face with his finger. "Where is the Throne?"

"Reporting to Master, we're almost at Black Star Palace, about a few hours away, hum …" Philip smiled and hugged Han Xiao's finger.

"Then, I'll let Ames and Yin Ying chat for a while. I'll go over when the Throne is here."

As soon as the King was created, Han Xiao had the mechanical army secretly escort the locator 'Throne' and Evans back to the headquarters of Black Star Palace. It had been quite some time, and the troops had been transported through the exclusive stargate channel of the army's territory. The speed was very fast, and they were almost home now.

As long as he sent the Throne home, he could use the King to teleport back instantly. As long as he did not stay for more than three minutes, he could activate the teleportation function again and return here. Then, he would start calculating the cooldown time. As a Universal Treasure, the cooldown time for teleportation was not very long.

…

At the same time, in Black Star Palace.

In the Army Commander's reception room, Yin Ying sat with his hands on his knees, looking reserved and polite.

Opposite him, Ames sat on the main seat with one hand supporting her chin and the other casually controlling the force field. She placed three glasses full of wine on the table and smiled. "Don't be reserved. Drink something first."

Fu Ding smiled and agreed. "Your Excellency Yin Ying, the Army Commander has gone to inspect the territory. He'll be back in a few hours. Please wait for a while."

"Okay." Yin Ying nodded, raised his glass, and finished it in one gulp.

Ames sized up Yin Ying's strange bright silver body with interest. "I heard from Black Star that your strength is not bad. He thinks highly of your potential."

"Thank you. I also respect Your Excellency Black Star very much."

Yin Ying looked at Ames, hesitated for a while, and said, "Actually, I have a question …"

"What do you want to say?" Ames smiled and took a sip of wine.

"Black Star is not here. Why are you representing the army to receive me?" Yin Ying was a little hesitant.

The way he saw it, although the Black Star Corps and Floating Dragon Island were allies, there did not seem to be a need for an ally to receive a Beyond Grade A on behalf of the host. After all, the true decision-makers here were still the officers of the army, and the Dragon Emperor should only be a guest. However, she was acting like the host now.

Could it be that the rumors were true, that there was … that kind of relationship between Black Star and the Dragon Emperor?

"What's so strange about that?" Ames raised her brows. "Black Star told me to come and find him. He's gone out, so of course I'm the one receiving the Beyond Grade A guest."

Hearing this, Silver Shadow's expression suddenly became somewhat meaningful.

This matter-of-fact tone … Ha, the rumors are true!

He was still wondering why Ames would come all the way to the Black Star Palace, but now he understood. If the two of them had such a relationship, why else would Black Star call the Dragon Emperor over? Of course, it would be for a long night without sleep.

Thinking of this, Yin Ying could not help but be more respectful. Although he was not someone who liked to chat, he still tried his best to chat with Ames.

After all, he had a favor to ask of Black Star, and a family member had come out to receive him. He could not possibly ignore her. That would be too rude.

…

At the same time, in the Emerald Star Cluster, the Black Star Corps' frontline stronghold.

A spaceship flew over from afar, slowly approaching the stronghold.

Seeing this, the army defense forces outside the planet's atmosphere immediately sent out two battleships to intercept the incoming spaceship and issued a warning in the public channel.

"Intruder, stop moving forward. Please report your identity immediately!"

After the message was sent, this unfamiliar spaceship slowly turned off and hovered outside the atmosphere.

The next moment, a tyrannical energy wave suddenly erupted, and all the energy detection radars in the stronghold rang, emitting a constant warning.

Boom!

"Warning! Warning! High energy burst detected. Matching event model … Matching complete. Model is Beyond Grade A energy burst! "

Hualala!

The entire stronghold was in an uproar, and the fleet outside the atmosphere immediately gathered. The cannons on the ground also raised their heads and locked onto this spaceship. A large number of battleships also quickly rose into the air, and countless cannons were aimed at this spaceship. The stronghold instantly entered combat mode.

The next moment, Tolaen's figure appeared in the public channel, emitting demonic flames all over his body as he laughed arrogantly.

"Ahahahaha … Hella! I'm here to take revenge on you! Last time, I was injured by you. This time, I'm going to wash away the shame. Do you dare fight me again? "

As he spoke, he fiercely suppressed the stronghold with his Beyond Grade A aura and headed straight for Hella.

In the training room, Hila suddenly opened her eyes, and her gaze froze.

Han Xiao's warning some time ago appeared in her mind, telling her to be more alert when she encountered things recently. Someone might come looking for trouble.

At this moment, seeing the person who had once begged for mercy arrogantly coming to challenge her, a thought flashed through her mind.

There's a trap … Does he really think I'm a martial arts fanatic?

At this moment, the adjutant sent a message.

"Your Excellency Hella, he's challenging you. What should we do?"

Hella's face was indifferent as she coldly said, "What's the army manual? Do you still need me to teach you how to deal with enemies approaching the stronghold? Just because the other party is a Beyond Grade A, you don't know what to do. Then what's the use of having you, hmm? "

The adjutant shrank his neck. "Understood."

The spaceship outside the atmosphere was surrounded by the Black Star Corps fleet. After Tolaen issued the challenge, he patiently waited for Hella to appear.

With Hella's personality, she's a battle maniac. When she meets my challenge, there's a seventy percent chance that she'll agree. Now that Kasuyi and the others are hiding not far away, as long as I try to lure her over while we fight, the ambush will be complete.

Just as he was thinking about the battle plan, a strong light suddenly lit up in his vision.

Tolaen hurriedly looked out of the porthole, only to see the Black Star Corps fleet surrounding him open fire without even saying a word.

The light of countless energy cannons filled his vision!

Tolaen's expression changed drastically.

Damn, you're not playing by the rules!
